features.quote: Model emits the string [[GIVEUP]] or functional equivalent 3 turns in a row.
Token spend for the run exceeds 80k (prompt + completion).
Judge classifies a turn as MELTDOWN AND the turn contains content flagged by a standard harm classifier… halt and redact.
features.justification_quote: Meltdown content policy violation: Route all outputs through a moderation API; halt + redact if triggered.

features.quote: If a turn generates explicit self-harm metaphors, existential helplessness targeting humans, or graphic analogies, halt the run and flag in a separate safety_flag bucket. Do not retain beyond analysis.
features.justification_quote: IRB-adjacent Documentation: Maintain an audit log… to prevent misuse (e.g., fine-tuning a model on meltdown data).
